title: Compatible completion map induced by a local homomorphism
statement: Let φ : A → B be a local homomorphism of commutative local rings. Their maximal-ideal adic completions [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion] admit a ring homomorphism ψ such that, for each n ≥ 0, if the n-th coordinate of x in the source completion is the class of a in A/m_A^n, then the n-th coordinate of ψ(x) is the class of φ(a) in B/m_B^n. No Noetherian hypothesis is needed.

proof.text: Locality gives φ(m_A) ⊆ m_B and hence φ(m_A^n) ⊆ m_B^n for every n, including n = 0. Ideal.Quotient.lift induces the quotient maps [def-weil-pbc-algebra-hom-quotient]. Compose them with evaluation of the source completion [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion]. Compatibility with factorPow follows from compatibility of the source coordinates. AdicCompletion.liftRingHom assembles the map; evalₐ_comp_liftRingHom and the quotient lift formula give the required coordinates.
